name: @pipeworx/mcp-gsa-perdiem

tools.name: rates_by_city
tools.description: Get US federal per diem rates (government travel lodging and meal allowances) for a city by name and state. Returns the monthly lodging ceiling (per-diem lodging varies by month/season), the flat M&IE (meals & incidental expenses) daily total, and its breakdown into breakfast, lunch, dinner, incidental expenses and the first/last travel day amount (meals_breakdown). Answers "GSA FY2026 M&IE breakdown for Nashville, TN", "federal per diem for Denver, CO", "government hotel rate cap in San Francisco". Example: rates_by_city({ city: "Denver", state: "CO" }).

year.description: Fiscal/rate year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current year.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own api.data.gov / GSA API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: rates_by_zip
tools.description: Get US federal per diem rates (government travel lodging and meal allowances) for a location by zip code. Returns the monthly lodging ceiling (per-diem lodging varies by month/season), the flat M&IE (meals & incidental expenses) daily total, and its breakdown into breakfast, lunch, dinner, incidental expenses and the first/last travel day amount (meals_breakdown). Answers "GSA M&IE breakdown for zip 37203", "federal per diem for 80202". Example: rates_by_zip({ zip: "80202" }).

year.description: Fiscal/rate year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current year.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own api.data.gov / GSA API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: mie_breakdown
tools.description: US federal per diem MEALS AND INCIDENTAL EXPENSES (M&IE) nationwide tier table: the GSA tiers (68, 74, 80, 86, 92 in FY2026) that split a daily M&IE total into breakfast, lunch, dinner and incidental expenses, plus the reduced first/last travel day amount. The table is organised by dollar tier. Use for "how much is the per diem lunch allowance", "what are the GSA M&IE tiers for FY2026", "what is the incidental expense rate". Pass `total` (a daily M&IE total, e.g. 86) to get that tier; omit it to list all tiers. A question that names a city or a zip code is answered by rates_by_city or rates_by_zip, which return that place's M&IE total together with its breakdown. Example: mie_breakdown({ year: 2026, total: 86 }).

year.description: Federal fiscal year, e.g. 2026 (Oct 2025 - Sep 2026). Defaults to the current year.

total.description: Optional daily M&IE total to look up, e.g. 86. Omit to list every tier.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own api.data.gov / GSA API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gsa-perdiem forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gsa-perdiem pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
